message.text: The group 'SELLER CONTACT' (BG-6) must be transmitted.
'Payment account identifier' (BT-84) should be a correct IBAN when 'Payment means type code' (BT-81) is 58 (SEPA).
'Specification identifier' (BT-24) should syntactically match the XRechnung standard identifier.
